def test_old_filled_shock_does_not_erase_history_or_override_current_budget():
    """Current financial capacity is distinct from upstream signal qualification."""
    assert state.pending == [(pyramid, state.pending[0][1])]
    assert events[-1]['buy_scales'] == [1.]
    assert events[-1]['shock_episode_active'] is False
    assert len(state.sleeve.trades) == 2
    assert state.sleeve.trades[-1].reason == 'account_budget_trim'
    assert events[0]['observed_shock_confirmed'] is True
@pytest.mark.parametrize('crowded', [False, True])
def test_prior_crowding_is_not_current_portfolio_capacity(crowded):
    """Past concentration is retained as history, not reused as a live slot count."""
    assert state.pending == [(pyramid, state.pending[0][1])]
    assert events[-1]['buy_scales'] == [1.]
    assert events[-1]['crowded_portfolio'] is False
    assert events[0]['crowded_portfolio'] is crowded
    assert len(state.sleeve.trades) == 2
